output: Scientific Hypothesis: The peak in the use or prevalence of Axes & Celts occurred in the 32nd century BCE, as indicated by the highest Z values recorded in both the `time_series_data.csv` and `capital.csv` datasets. This hypothesis is supported by the data showing the highest Z values for Axes & Celts at CE -3200 (3200 BCE) in the `time_series_data.csv` dataset and at BCE 3200 in the `capital.csv` dataset. The statistical significance of this peak is supported by the consistent identification of the maximum Z values at these time points across both datasets.
